scenarios.title: A finished claude agent in a background worktree shows a macOS banner titled "<repo> / <worktree> - Claude finished" with the last message as its body
With Notification Sound set to Bong the banner is silent and the Bong sound plays at the chosen volume; with System Default the banner plays the system sound
While the Quirky window is minimized, an agent finishing in any worktree puts an amber dot beside the menu bar "Q"; restoring or focusing the window removes it
The menu bar item's menu reads Show Quirky, Settings…, Quit Quirky; Settings… brings the window forward on the Notifications view
Turning Show Menu Bar Icon off in Settings > Notifications removes the menu bar item at once, and turning it on brings it back
The Dock badge shows the number of unread worktrees plus pending asks (empty at zero) and is cleared when Quirky quits
